'''Wolver''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] who served on the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vengeance (Imperial-class, Jerec)|''Vengeance'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[0 ABY/Legends|Nine months after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Wolver and Lieutenant [[Tier]] accompanied [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] on a trip to [[S'krrr]] to study [[S'krrr (species)|S'krrr]] art. While Thrawn was studying the [[Sikadian Garden]]s, Wolver left the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Tessera]]'' to deliver a message to his commander. However, as he made his way to Thrawn, he was attacked by a swarm of [[drog]] beetles and eaten alive. When Thrawn later discovered the body, along with [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak]] and [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], he launched a murder investigation to uncover the cause of Wolver's death.
